name: Uptime
description: HTTP(S), TCP, TLS certificate expiry and DNS checks with latency graphs and down/expiry alerts.

checks.title: Checks
checks.description: One check per line: <kind> <target> [name=] [interval=] [timeout=] [keyword=] [expect=] [record=] [value=]. Kinds: http, tcp, tls, dns.

default_interval.title: Default interval
default_interval.description: How often each check runs unless it sets interval=.

default_timeout.title: Default timeout
default_timeout.description: How long a check may take unless it sets timeout=.

down_after_runs.title: Down after failed runs
down_after_runs.description: Raise a critical alert after this many consecutive failures.

cert_warn_days.title: Warn when a certificate expires in fewer than (days)
